title: Supplementary Information for Spurious Precision in Meta-Analysis of Observational Research
parent_label: Spurious Precision in Meta-Analysis of Observational Research
reference_line: Zuzana Irsova, Pedro R. D. Bom, Tomas Havranek, and Heiko Rachinger (2025), Supplementary Information for "Spurious precision in meta-analysis of observational research." Nature Communications 16, 8454.
abstract: The supplementary information for the MAIVE paper: the full simulation designs and their results, the empirical applications, additional simulations, twenty-nine supplementary figures and nine supplementary tables.
